Quick Bio

I am a Ph.D. Student studying Computer Science at University of Wisconsin-Madison, funded as a NSF GRFP fellow. My research is focused on characterizing and scaling AI workloads on high-performance computing platforms.

Previously, I completed my undergraduate degree at Grand Valley State University, studying Computer Science with minors in mathematics and writing.
